_comment: 朝礼ページ 練習の 節（「あなたも 朝礼を やって みよう」）の 絵。2026-09-15 の 指定で「Grabの 配車機能／Foodpandaの 商品一覧画面／ABA銀行の 決済画面 の どれかの チームに なった つもりで」を 足した ときの 絵。実在の ロゴ・会社名は 描かない（名前は 本文に だけ 書く）。
style: Warm modern anime illustration, like a friendly Japanese educational manga — clean confident black linework, flat cel shading with gentle light, bright natural daylight, soft pastel palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded friendly shapes. A tidy contemporary Japanese software office with real desks, chairs, windows, plants, mugs and laptops. People are drawn as real human beings with natural proportions, warm friendly faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Every picture is a REAL PLACE seen from a natural camera angle, and the subject FILLS THE WHOLE FRAME. This one is a teaching diagram: few large elements, generous spacing, each label sitting on a soft cream panel with a rounded border, arranged so the eye reads it in one pass.
noText: Japanese lettering — read this part carefully. The picture contains ONLY the Japanese words listed in the scene above, and no other writing at all. Print each word LARGE and horizontally in a rounded gothic Japanese font, with generous space around it. Directly above every kanji, print its reading in small hiragana (furigana), centred over that kanji, clearly separated from it, at about 45% of the kanji height, so that the kanji and the furigana both stay sharp and easy to read at a glance. Words written only in hiragana or katakana take no furigana. Spell every character exactly as given. No other letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the picture.
negative: Never: photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry or crying faces, watermarks, real company logos or brand marks of any kind, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, tiny cluttered text, paragraphs of text, 3D render, flat vector icon art, pictograms floating on an empty background, robots, mascots.

scenes.title: 3つの アプリの 画面（配車機能・商品一覧画面・決済画面）
scenes.where: content/articles/asakai_lecture.json 7．あなたも 朝礼を やって みよう
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: choose one of these three apps and imagine you are on the team that builds it. A teaching diagram of three large rounded cream cards side by side on a soft sky-blue background. Each card holds one big smartphone standing upright, with a Japanese label panel across the top of the card. Card 1: the phone shows a simple ride-hailing map screen with streets, a small car mark and a pickup pin; the label reads 配車機能. Card 2: the phone shows a food delivery product list screen with rows of small dish pictures and blank price lines; the label reads 商品一覧画面. Card 3: the phone shows a bank payment screen with a QR code, a blank amount line and one big rounded pay button; the label reads 決済画面. No people. No brand names, no logos and no app names anywhere — the screens are generic. Few large elements, generous spacing.
